text: Hello, everyone.Long time no see.How have you been?Welcome to surface class again.Before we start the lesson, make sure you get your student's book, notebook, and worksheet ready.It is probably the last online lesson for this semester, a revision lesson.Today, we are mainly focusing on three units, the topics of which are encyclopedias, nobody wins one, and nobody wins two.Like what we did last time, here I've got a checklist for you to assess how well you know the three units.This is task one on your worksheet.Please read the statements and put the text in the right boxes.Okay, are you done with it?Let's just put the checklist aside for the later use.Let's get warmed up with a vocabulary task.Complete the sentences with the given words in their proper forms.This is exercise A in task two on your worksheet.Let's check the answers.Number one, we need a plural form here, a plural noun, so the answer should be photos.How do you form the prunals of potato, hero, and tomato?Well done, but pay attention to your pronunciation, prunal.Number two, the answer is nines.Pay attention to the spelling.What do we call the number?We call it an ordinal number.Right, an ordinal number tells the position or order of things.We can also use an cardinal number to express the ninth grade.We say grade nine.Good.Number three, clearly.Just add the suffix ly after the adjective clear.We use this adverb to modify the verb shoes.Generally, adverbs are put directly after the verbs, they modify.Adverbs can also go before the verb, or between a helping verb and the main verb.Number four, powerful, an adjective which modifies the laser torch.The suffix f-u-l means full of.Can you name some adjectives ending in f-u-l?What did Captain King use the powerful laser torch to do?The laser beam hit Gork in the eye.Wow, you can recall every detail.Number five, dead.Generally, we put adjectives after the link verb such as be, become, look, etc.as predictive 表语.The word dead is an adjective that describes a state.That means no longer alive.And we don't use has died with a period of time.We say the thinker died 2,000 years ago.Number six, safety.In this sentence, to is a preposition rather than an infinitive, so we put a noun in the blank.If you reach safety, you reach a place where you are safe from danger.Number seven, frightened.It is after a to infinitive, so we use a verb here.You know who said the sentence?Mahatma Gandhi, considered as father of the nation in India.Who is known as the father of the nation in modern China?Sun Ya Sen, right?Number eight, harmless.Pay attention to the linking word, but which connects ideas that contrast?Making noise is something bad, so we can infer that the dog causes no harm at all.Adding the suffix l-e-s-s to the end of words gives these words the opposite meaning.Examples like this are homeless, careless, helpless, and useless.Word formation is a kind of exercise you will find in some exam papers.In this task, you have to change the word given so that it fits the sentence logically and grammatically.When you do the task, read the whole sentence to get a good idea of the context.What type of word do they need?Then look at the word you have to change.Think about the words that are in the same word family.Try thinking of the usual prefixes and suffixes.With word formation exercises, you learn words in packages, which help improve your vocabulary.Also, word formation adds to your language feeling.You will soon see that you can guess new forms based on the stem you already know, and you will even be able to invent your own words to create a humorous effect.Now, let's practice our vocabulary in the sentence translation exercise.It is exercise B in task 2 on your worksheet.Let's look at the sentences together.Sentence 1You have to work faster.We run out of time.Good choice of the phrase run out of.But I would suggest using the present continuous tense to talk about future that is going to happen very, very soon.可以用現在進行時表示很快就要發生的動作。So, my answer is, we are running out of time.Miss Yu, can I say we only have little time?Of course you can.You can also say we don't have much time left.This would sound more natural.Sentence 2The repair of the museum cost much more than we were expecting.I'm afraid there were mistakes in your sentence.We don't say the repair of something.We say the repair to something.This is what we call collocation.Noun-proposition-collocation.名詞和介詞的搭配。As a noun, repair can be both countable and uncountable.We use repairs to imply a list of tasks to do.For example, painting the door, putting new glass in broken windows, and replacing the roof.Sentence 3If you want to learn more about the giant panda, you had better look up the encyclopedia.I'm afraid we don't say look up the encyclopedia.We say look something up or look up something in the encyclopedia or dictionary.Here something refers to the giant panda.To avoid repetition, we use it instead.And pay attention to the position of the pronoun it.Since up is an adverb, we put it in the middle of the phrase.Can you give more examples?Pick it up, put it up, throw it away, turn it off.Good job.Another point to notice in the sentence.We use had better do something to give advice.No to after had better.Sentence 4The crew will be in big trouble if they go into the cave.Excellent.I'm glad you avoid translating word for word.到大美 can be translated as being in big or great trouble.And the simple future tense with will is used here to talk about possible situations in the future.Next sentence.The kangaroos voluntarily took the spaceman out of the cave.I guess you use a Chinese English dictionary.Voluntarily does have the meaning of without being forced.But we have a better word for this, offer.The kangaroos offered to ask someone if they would like you to do something.So in this case, we say the kangaroos offered to take the spaceman out of the cave.Sentence 6Some students are having a barbecue.The others are putting the chairs in a circle.If you use the others, that means the students are divided into two groups.Then the Chinese would be 剩下的.But here the Chinese given is 有的.The pronoun others would fit the sentence better.Others may simply mean different, additional.Also, the word put can be replaced by arrange.When we put a group of objects in a particular order, we use the word arrange.Clocations with arrange can be arranged flowers.The boy asks, Mom, what will take place on the lonely planet next?Well done.We use this simple future tense to describe an action that will happen in the future.The preposition on is used correctly.We say on the planet, on the planet, on the planet.The last one.I don't know how to say 主动.My sentence is, most wild animals won't attack unless somebody disturb them.You can say 主动.You use the word attack, right?Attack means to deliberately use violence to hurt a person.Adverbs become redundant when they follow a strong verb that clearly conveys the degree of the action.英语中有些动词非常强的表达出动作的程度。这个时候再使用副词会显得多余。For example, one does not scream loudly because by definition, screaming is done loudly.And one mistake in your sentence, should somebody be used with a singular verb or a plural one?Singular, right?So the sentence should be, most wild animals won't attack unless somebody disturbs them.I would say you use the tense perfectly.Translation exercise is challenging but fun, isn't it?We've already learned some tips on sentence translation.Benny, can you recall them?Well, we should avoid translating word for word, and we should be careful with grammar such as the tenses, the subject-verb agreement, sentence structures.Also, we need to have a good command of vocabulary.Good for you.Remember the tips when you do translation.With sentence translation exercise, you will definitely increase accuracy in your writing, and your grammar and vocabulary will be consolidated.Next, let's do a listening task.You will hear a short conversation between the teacher and some parents about some arrangements.Listen and complete the sentences.This is task three on your worksheet.Before the recording starts, look at the sentences.What information is missing?A noun, a verb, a number, a date, a name.Predict what information you need and listen.To confirm.Listening, a teacher is talking to parents about a planned hostel in Hawkshed.Sorry, staying where?Hawkshed, that's H-A-W-K-S-H-E-A-D.The full address and all the details are on these handouts for you to take home.Now, we have to leave at 11 a.exactly, so important to us.Finally, if you do not want your son or daughter to go, could you please sign the blue form?Of course, I hope all the students can come with us to the beautiful part of England.Now, does anyone have any questions?Did you get everything done?These are possible answers.Remember, in exams, you hear everything twice, so don't worry if you are not sure after the first time.When you
